extra_seeds_group_e.description: Fresh n=13 target-45 seeds to broaden positive-label coverage
extra_seeds_group_e.note: Exact subset frozen at F0 in seeds-development-v2.json; decision is binary and irrevocable

split_policy.note: PENDING_F0_FREEZE — split is redesigned to ensure positive-label coverage in the training partition
split_policy.goal: At least one positive-label seed must fall in the training split
approach_options: Include Group-E seeds (1001–1020) in training; seed 18 remains in calibration
Resplit v1 seeds so that seed 18 (sole positive source) is in training, not calibration only

format.raw: UTF-8 tab-separated rows with one frozen header; no quoting
format.aggregate: raw per-seed files plus one zstd-compressed concatenation
format.float_format: decimal with 9 significant digits, parsed as float32
format.sequence_encoding: lower-upper pairs separated by semicolons; present only when final_count <= 45

feature_columns: f000 through f(N-1) in features-v2 index order; N frozen at F0

instrumentation.enabled_only_by: MERICANII_DATASET_PATH absolute path plus MERICANII_DATASET_SEED matching ec.rand.seed
instrumentation.sentinel_requirement: instrumentation-off and instrumentation-on produce identical 50200 evaluations, final sequence, and final size
